Description: Summon Kamuy of the Nine Tails, legendary auspice, completely independent from Kyubi of the Nine Tails.
Summon the Kamuy of the Nine Tails, legendary auspice, completely independent from Kyubi of the Nine Tails.

スターライトスレイに騎乗する。
星芒祭で作られた大型のソリ。トナカイ付き
Summon forth your Starlight sleigh. Comes complete with a reindeer to draw you forth in festive cheer.
DescriptionEnhanced: 星芒祭のため、グリダニアの有志が協力して作り上げた大型ソリ。飾り付けをはじめ、細部に子どもたちの一生懸命な仕事ぶりがうかがえる。ベルを鳴らせば気分は上々、星屑の煌めきが聖人の従者を祝福するだろう

Created for the Starlight Celebration by Gridanian volunteers, this reindeer-drawn sleigh bears the children's touches in the decorative details and more. Ringing the equipped handbell serves not only to brighten spirits, but also unleashes a swirl of twinkling stars to bless all nearby.
Tooltip:
Isn't it the best sleigh
you've ever seen?
   - Aitken

Description: Call into battle your Hardy-Daytona, a lore-bending battlebike that will have you feeling as though you were playing a minigame.
Call into battle your Hardy-Daytona, a lore-bending battlebike that will have you feeling as though you were playing a mini-game.
Summon forth your Night Stallion, a replica of Hardiboiled's beloved air-wheeler.
DescriptionEnhanced: This Night Stallion is a replica of Hardiboiled's beloved air-wheeler, though only in appearance, for the detective's vehicle is tuned to produce so much power, it would be dangerous in the hands of any but himself. The output of this model is factory stock, making it far more manageable.
Tooltip:
He's a custom job
built for yours truly.
   - Hardiboiled

Description: Call into action your magitek scorpion. Bears no armaments, so poses no danger whether its tail is up or down.
DescriptionEnhanced: Commissioned to produce a prize for the Gold Saucer, the engineers of Garlond Ironworks opted to create this replica of the magitek scorpion. By forgoing armaments and rethinking materials from the ground up, they succeeded in reducing size and weight and minimizing energy consumption.
Tooltip:
Remember to attack
while it's tail's up!
   - Alliance Soldier

Description: Summon forth your colibri callado, a deceptively strong cloudkin that can carry several times its weight.
DescriptionEnhanced: Native to the Occult Crescent, this colibri was found whipping Garula into a frenzy, which prompted Ketenramm to intervene and subdue the creature. It was subsequently trained to serve as a beast of burden, and has traded its foul-mouthed cawing for dignified silence.
Tooltip:
I'm still hungry enough to eat
a whole roasted colibri.
   - Wuk Lamat

Description: Summon forth your duck-billed porter. Has retired from locksmithing, so won't be opening any locks for you.
DescriptionEnhanced: Encountered on the Occult Crescent, this familiar bearing a resemblance to the duckbill (the creature, not the footwear) is believed to have served a sorcerer during the War of the Magi. Originally a locksmith, it has since chosen to become a porter, the better to attend to you.
Tooltip:
We have to find that porter
right this instant!
   - Tataru
